constraints: Treat `og sync` as the single autonomous orchestration entrypoint so locking, dedupe, policy, and safety remain centralized.
Resolve diff baselines in the documented order: `HEAD~1`, then `git merge-base ORIG_HEAD HEAD`, then a synthetic empty-tree baseline.

Filter `.outcomegraph/work/**`, `.outcomegraph/cache/**`, `.outcomegraph/events/**`, and `.outcomegraph/objects/**` before mapping changes; if filtering removes all diff paths, the pass is unchanged unless a full-sync flag is requested.
Keep worker execution behind the `WorkerAdapter` boundary; Codex v1 is the current implementation, not the architectural contract.
Validate worker outputs against schema and policy before artifact-store writes are applied.
Run verification continuously across fast, replay, and resilience loops rather than treating verification as a final one-time step.

Isolate each replay candidate in `.outcomegraph/work/replay/<run_id>/<capsule_id>/`, seed it from a clean baseline plus materialized lock inputs, compare oracle evidence and behavior hashes to canonical baselines, emit replay certificates with sandbox provenance, and garbage-collect by policy.

Require adapter manifests to include `schema_version`, `type`, `name`, `implementation_version`, and `interface_version`, and enforce interface version `1` compatibility for worker, oracle, sandbox, store, and exporter adapters.
Fail startup for required adapter absence or incompatibility with actionable diagnostics, including `ADAPTER_INTERFACE_MISMATCH`; optional adapters may warn and continue in disabled-feature mode.
Keep Git-tracked state to compact replayable truth while storing bulky runtime exhaust outside Git by default.
In observe mode, limit automatic writes to OutcomeGraph artifacts and configured exports; broader product-code edits are out of scope.
Run all candidate writes, network calls, dependency actions, and deploys through the policy evaluator, and require explicit `--mode autonomous` before allowlisted writes or deploys may execute.
goal: Capture the canonical OutcomeGraph and Steward architecture contract, with `og sync` as the central orchestration path and defined boundaries for change detection, distillation, verification, plugins, safety, data handling, and recovery.

oracles.name: `ARCHITECTURE.md` is the authoritative evidence snapshot for the architecture capsule in this run.
The payload does not provide a repo-native executable verification contract for this capsule, so validation remains document-backed rather than command-backed.
